rca of the issue: Initial pytest failure on test_query_multipart_creator_ok_and_encrypted_at_rest: 'Cite la phrase exacte' not in plain text. Root cause = services.crypto loads LAURENTIA_ENCRYPTION_KEY at module import. The pytest process imports crypto BEFORE python-dotenv loads /app/backend/.env, so the test uses the placeholder _DEFAULT_KEY while the running server (which calls load_dotenv on startup) uses the real key. Decryption of server-encrypted blobs in the test process therefore returned empty string. Fix: add /app/backend/tests/conftest.py that calls load_dotenv() at import time, guaranteeing the same key is available before any test module imports services.crypto. Re-run: 17/17 + 6/6 green.
